product.title: NW Aluminum 840
product.description: Aluminum framed folding glass door for superior thermal performance. NW Aluminum 840 is NanaWall’s slim aluminum framed folding glass door engineered for superior thermal performance and taller heights. It is a floor-supported system with a crisp, angular design, minimal exposed hardware, and an intersection of two folding panels measuring 3 7/8" (99 mm). The system is available in inswing or outswing configurations, accommodates open corner designs, and integrates FourFold or SixFold panel sets.
